title: Sentiment Bundle Benchmark
subtitle: Compare sentiment models on the same terms
description: TF-IDF, embeddings, fine-tuned encoders and a local language model, evaluated on fixed splits across six sentiment datasets. The successor to GURA.
longDescription: A reproducible sentiment-classification benchmark across MyAnimeList reviews and five classic English datasets. Fixed splits and seeds support comparisons of accuracy, macro-F1, training time, inference speed, memory and model size. It replaces the older GURA BiGRU experiment.
features: Six datasets with fixed splits and seeds
TF-IDF, embeddings, ModernBERT, DeBERTa-v3 and local-model baselines
Accuracy, macro-F1, runtime, memory and model-size reports
Dataset bundle available on Hugging Face
